{{BSE|544311}} | founded = {{Start date and age|1975}} in [[Antwerp]], [[Belgium]] | parent = {{ubl|[[Blackstone Group]]|{{smaller|(2023–present)}}}} | hq_location_city = [[Mumbai]] | hq_location_country = India | hq_location = | num_locations = | area_served = | key_people = | industry = [[Gemstone#Grading|Gemstone grading]] | products = | services = | market cap = | revenue = | operating_income = | net_income = | assets = | equity = | owner = | num_employees = | divisions = | subsidiaries = | website = {{URL|https://igi.org/}} | footnotes = | intl = }} '''International Gemological Institute''' ('''IGI''') is a gemological organization which certifies [[diamond]], [[gemstone|coloured stone]] and [[jewellery]]. It was established in 1975 in Belgium.{{cite news|first=Rebecca|last=Roe|title=Spotlight on International Gemological Institute|publisher=Jewelers Inc. |date=December 2007}} On 21 May 2023, [[Blackstone Group]] announced their acquisition of IGI.{{Cite web|url=https://www.blackstone.com/news/press/blackstone-acquires-international-gemological-institute-igi/|title= Blackstone Acquires International Gemological Institute (IGI)|work=Blackstone|access-date=2023-09-14|language=en-US}} ==History== In March 2007, IGI collaborated with the Tanzanite Foundation to help distribute jewellery certificates using a grading scale called the Tanzanite Quality Scale (TQS), for the gem called [[Tanzanite]], which was discovered in [[Tanzania]] in the 1960s.{{cite news |first=Diana |last=Jarrett |title=Tanzanite Makes the Grade |work=Rapaport Diamond Report |date=November 2, 2007}}{{cite web|url=http://www.colored-stone.com/stories/mar07/tanzanite.cfm|title=Tanzanite Foundation, IGI Team Up on Grading|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080908085100/http://www.colored-stone.com/stories/mar07/tanzanite.cfm|date=March 22, 2007|archive-date=2008-09-08}} In April 2010, IGI opened a laboratory in [[Surat]], its fifth diamond grading laboratory in India.{{cite web|url=http://www.diamonds.net/News/NewsItem.aspx?ArticleID=30566&ArticleTitle=IGI+Launches+in+the+Heart+of+the+Diamond+Industry|title=Diamonds.net - IGI Launches in the Heart of the Diamond Industry|date=2010-04-15}} ==Operations== IGI has a staff of over 650 gemologists, appraisers and professional office personnel.{{cite news|title=IGI's Online Services Provide a Consumer-Friendly Approach to Diamond and Gemstone Education and Protection|work=Mid-America Jewelry News |date=October 2007 }} IGI provides its services to the public through diamond dealers, and jewellery manufactures. IGI provides independent grading reports, coloured stone reports, identification and appraisal reports, diamond authentication and attestations of origin, and laser inscription services. They also offers diamond and coloured stone courses through IGI's Schools of Gemology.{{cite web|url=http://www.diamonds.net/News/NewsItem.aspx?ArticleID=1354&ArticleTitle=IGI+Offering+Rough+Diamond+Course|title=Diamonds.net – IGI Offering Rough Diamond Course|date=1996-09-06}} Graduates from the IGI school of Gemology are awarded an IGI Diploma. ==Market position== IGI is the largest laboratory for certification of diamonds and fine jewellery.{{cite news |title= About IGI: JCK Online |url=http://jck.firstlightera.com/EN/Microsites/1/International+Gemological+Institute/ec89e412-a92c-44aa-be25-43baa2b63d58 |work=JCK Online |date= |access-date=2008-06-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080419080946/http://jck.firstlightera.com/EN/Microsites/1/International+Gemological+Institute/ec89e412-a92c-44aa-be25-43baa2b63d58|archive-date=2008-04-19}} IGI is [[International Organization for Standardization]] (ISO) 9001: 2000 certified in four countries, including the United States, Canada, India and the United Arab Emirates.{{Citation International Gemological Institute (IGI) is a gemological organization which certifies diamond, coloured stone and jewellery. It was established in 1975 in Belgium.
On 21 May 2023, Blackstone Group announced their acquisition of IGI.
